description: A Christmas journey on the Orient Express leads into 2026 questions on mythology, theatre, horror, Scottish history and other eclectic subjects as Clarkson continues putting six contestants at a time through the Millionaire chair.

s11e01.description: Peter Pan, WhatsApp, toadstools, boas, the British census, Roman aqueducts, Rick Stein’s Padstow connection and Feliz Navidad all appear in the Boxing Day ladder before rail history reaches the Orient Express.

s11e02.description: Musical films are put in release order before bedside manner, garden gnomes, blizzards, meeting minutes, lunar tides, kedgeree, blackjack and Snowdon routes all appear. Drama eventually supplies the Theatre of the Absurd.

s11e03.description: BBC Sports Personality history, barbells, the US First Lady, heart-to-heart talks, toilet-cistern ballcocks, chives, the Spice Girls’ Wannabe and the jive all appear before Greek mythology introduces Cassandra and her famously untrusted prophecies.

s11e04.description: Capillaries, Bon Jovi, cauliflower as gobi in Indian cuisine and the wording of the Gettysburg Address all appear around a horror-film detour to the Overlook Hotel from The Shining. Even a G and T gets a question.

s11e05.description: Starlight Express, Lisbeth Salander, nephrology, the Paddington films, Magellan and Constable’s The Hay Wain all feature around a fashion question about Versace’s logo and the head of Medusa.

s11e06.description: British TV shows are ordered by debut before polling stations, Little Red Riding Hood, darts bullseyes, mohawks, Five Gold Rings, Armageddon and the Old Fashioned cocktail enter the ladder. Scottish history and language later bring in Caledonia.
